gateError.GATE_REF_SYSTEM_DOMAIN_READ_ONLY: Change refused: this list is maintained by Maintafox and cannot be changed in Reference data. Its values stay available in the forms that use them.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_NOT_ACTIVE: Unit refused: it does not exist or is no longer active in Reference data. Choose an active unit.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_DIMENSION_MISMATCH: Conversion refused: the two units do not measure the same quantity (for example a mass and a length).
gateError.GATE_UNIT_DIMENSION_MISSING: Conversion refused: the physical dimension of one of the units is not set in Reference data.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_DIMENSION_INVALID: Unit refused: its physical dimension is not a known dimension.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_BASE_REQUIRED: Unit refused: a plant unit must name its base standard unit and the factor (e.g. 1 bag = 25 kg).
gateError.GATE_UNIT_BASE_INVALID: Unit refused: the base must be an active standard unit of the same dimension, and the factor a number greater than zero.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_FACTOR_MISSING: Conversion refused: one of the units has no base unit or factor yet (unit "to review" in Reference data). No factor is assumed.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_NO_CONVERSION: Conversion refused: no conversion is defined between these two units.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_GENERAL_FACTOR_ON_UNIT: Conversion refused: the general factor of a plant unit is set on the unit, in Reference data. Here, add a conversion for one article.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_MERGE_CHANGES_QUANTITIES: Merge refused: the two units do not stand for the same quantity (for example a 25 kg bag and the kilogram). Stock and readings using them would change meaning.
gateError.GATE_UNIT_WHOLE_UNITS: Quantity refused: converted to the stock unit it is not a whole number, and the article is serial-tracked.
gateError.GATE_WO_SHIFT_INVALID: Planning refused: the old shift codes (morning, afternoon, night, full day) are no longer used. Choose a shift of the team's Classe horaire.

gateError.GATE_WO_SHIFT_NO_DAY: Planning refused: enter the planned start before choosing the shift.

gateError.GATE_WO_SHIFT_TEAM_CHANGED: Assignment refused: the new team does not work the chosen shift on the planned day. Choose one of the new team's shifts, or no shift.
gateError.GATE_INV_PERIOD_CLOSED: Posting refused: this date falls in a closed inventory period. Use a date after the closed period.

gateError.GATE_PROC_AMOUNT_UNKNOWN: Approval refused: the document amount cannot be established. Enter the unit prices of its lines first.

scope.SCOPE_OUTSIDE_SITE: This record belongs to a site outside your roles.
scope.SCOPE_RECORD_WITHOUT_SITE: This record has no site: only a plant-wide role can act on it.
scope.SCOPE_PLANT_WIDE_ONLY: This is a plant-wide object: only a plant-wide role can act on it.
scope.SCOPE_ADMIN_ROLE_PLANT_WIDE: Administrator roles are plant-wide: they cannot be limited to a site.
scope.PERMIT_HANDOVER_NO_RECEIVER_AT_SITE: Nobody at this site holds the permit close right: no one can receive this hand-over. Ask an administrator to give the right at this site.
scope.PERMIT_HANDOVER_RECEIVER_NO_RIGHT: The receiving person does not hold the permit close right at this permit's site.
scope.PERMIT_EQUIPMENT_LOCKED: This permit was approved for this equipment. Cancel it and raise a new permit.
scope.PERMIT_EQUIPMENT_LOCK_FITTED: A lock is fitted under this permit and its removal has not been verified: its equipment cannot be changed. Cancel the permit, have the lock removal verified, then raise a new permit.
scope.PERMIT_EQUIPMENT_ISOLATIONS_PLANNED: Isolation points are planned on this permit for its current equipment: its equipment cannot be changed. Cancel the planned isolation lines, or cancel the permit and raise a new one for the new equipment.
scope.PERMIT_SITE_NOT_EQUIPMENT_SITE: A permit is recorded at the site of its equipment (or of its work order), or at a level above it: another site, or a level below, cannot be given.
scope.PERMIT_SITE_LOCKED: This permit was approved at this site: its site can no longer change. Cancel it and raise a new permit.
scope.PERMIT_WO_EQUIPMENT_MISMATCH: The permit's equipment must be the equipment of its work order.
scope.DI_ORG_NODE_REQUIRED: A request must be attached to a site: choose equipment installed on an org node.
